purpose: Individually trace every inventory entry to its underlying parcel, original land transaction and historical offering; preserve incomplete evidence and identity corrections.
queue_order: Frozen record IDs in data-center-history-queue.json: state postal code, county or city, name, ID.

write.optimistic_concurrency: GET the exact row's current version, preserve its complete data and supply expected_version. New rows use 0. Retain idempotent run_id for unchanged retries; corrections use a new run ID.
write.readback: Require readback_verified and GET /api/origination?run_id=<run_id>, then read back every modified row. Advance only after successful readback.

authentication: Use connected Site tools when available. Otherwise get_site for this exact project, verify owner-only access, and use its siwc_bypass_bearer_token only to this Site in OAI-Sites-Authorization: Bearer TOKEN. This is identity-less service access: do not invent visitor identity headers. Never store tokens in files, prompts, reports or data.
reservation: Before researching, save IN_PROGRESS with lease.owner=run_id and lease.expires_at (90 minutes). Existing unexpired reservations are excluded from next. Renew while active. A reservation is not a completed search. If a reservation expires, resume existing work instead of overwriting history.
reporting: Distinct counts: inventory entries, started, individually researched, exact parcels established, original purchases established, original offerings found, fully established histories, duplicates and unresolved identities. Do not equate source records with unique physical sites. No generic bulk search counts as individual review. Every run must state its actual receipt, cases researched, new facts and next queue position.
schema_and_research_rules:
# Individual data-center land-history research
Use ordered-register.json in this directory; queue_position is the 1-based array index. Research each assigned record individually, in order. Do not edit the Site checkout or other agents' files. Save your output as the assigned batch JSON and checkpoint after every completed investigation.

Output: {"schema_version":"dc-land-history-v1","records":[...]}.
Each record: {
"id":"dc-history-"+inventory.id,"record_id":inventory.id,"queue_position":n,
"facility_name":inventory.name,"state":inventory.state,"county":inventory.county,
"review_stage":"REVIEWED_PARTIAL|HISTORY_ESTABLISHED|IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED|DUPLICATE_LINKED|NOT_A_DATA_CENTER",
"checked_at":ISOdate,"summary":short factual summary,
"identity":{"address":null|string,"parcel_ids":[{"id":string,"jurisdiction":string,"source_ids":[]}],"confidence":"verified|probable|unresolved","relationships":[{"record_id":string,"relation":"same_campus|same_building|possible_duplicate","basis":string,"source_ids":[]}],"source_ids":[]},
"land_history":[{"event_kind":"original_land_purchase|improved_property_purchase|operating_asset_purchase|lease|option|public_land_allocation|proposed_transaction","date":null|string,"date_precision":string,"buyer":null|string,"deed_grantee":null|string,"seller":null|string,"acres":null|number,"price_usd":null|number,"price_basis":string,"scope":string,"source_ids":[]}],
"historical_listings":[{"url":string|null,"archive_url":string|null,"listing_date":null|string,"asking_price_usd":null|number,"acres":null|number,"offering_type":string,"match_basis":string,"source_ids":[]}],
"approvals":[{"authority":string,"date":null|string,"case_id":null|string,"type":string,"outcome":string,"notes":string,"source_ids":[]}],
"predevelopment":[{"description":string,"as_of":null|string,"source_ids":[]}],
"sources":[{"id":stable unique string,"url":string,"title":string,"publisher":string,"date":null|string,"retrieved_at":ISOdate,"source_type":"government|recorder|assessor|operator|broker|archived_listing|sec|news|directory","supports":string}],
"search_log":[{"query_or_locator":string,"source_family":"web|assessor|recorder|municipal|broker|archive|sec|operator","url":null|string,"result":"found|no_relevant_result|blocked|not_searched","note":string}],
"unresolved_fields":string[],"next_steps":string[],
"completion":{"identity":boolean,"parcel":boolean,"original_transaction":boolean,"original_listing":boolean,"approval_path":boolean},
"complete":boolean
}

Standards:
- Use public lawful sources, official parcel/recorder and municipal records, operator/SEC documents, broker sale releases, surviving listing pages, archived offering memoranda and Wayback when accessible.
- Search exact name, operator/address, seller/buyer SPVs and historical names. Trace the underlying land, not only current operating-asset acquisitions.
- At least investigate exact identity, acquisition search and original sale/lease offering/archive search for each record; identify the correct assessor/recorder next step if no public parcel result can be retrieved. Record actual searches and access blockers. Do not mark an unattempted source as searched.
- Every transaction, acreage, price, parcel and historical-listing match must have source IDs that resolve in that record. Distinguish asking vs closing price, assessed value vs consideration, capex vs purchase price, land vs improved property, campus vs building, owner vs lessee vs operator.
- Source snippets may support a tentative lead; mark it preliminary and retrieve the underlying page when possible. Do not fill missing fields from estimates.
- No original listing located does not mean no listing ever existed. Public lease/land allocation may have a solicitation instead of a sale; retain that as its actual offering type.
- A physical data center must be verified before matching transactions. Flag organization-only inventory entries, duplicate campuses and false positives. Do not inflate physical-site or transaction counts.
- Preserve failed/cancelled projects as such. A decision to buy land is not a closing; planning recommendation is not final approval.
- complete=true only if all five completion flags are supported (or a documented, sourced nonapplicability is explained). Otherwise retain REVIEWED_PARTIAL or IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED etc.
- Each record needs a meaningful next step. Exhaustively complete your bounded assigned records; do not stop after finding one attractive case.
- Do not contact anyone, spend, create accounts or bypass access controls. Do not use unrelated private data. No .html deliverables.
